strict_pointed_method.valid_use: Tests whether a Hebrew-script string presented as an exact pointed anchor occurs as the same pointed sequence after its stated limited normalization.
limits: Pointing or presentation differences can fail even when consonants collate.
An in-span shorter substring can pass without proving that the intended prefixed, suffixed, or clause-level source token was quoted completely.

backup_consonantal_method.valid_use: Tests consonantal token identity, prefixes, suffixes, order, and disclosed ketiv/qere structure while ignoring vocalization and format controls.
limits: Cannot validate an exact pointed quotation.
Its source_observation prose is encoding-damaged and cannot be used as lexical evidence.
